creator: Alexander Terp
description: crates/muster-cli/src/windowless.rs and crates/muster-seam/src/session.rs each compare speaks.minor with KEYS_IN_A_SEND, with near-identical refusals, while crates/muster-cli/src/messaging.rs uses a needs_minor(request) table. One helper in muster-daemon-proto::version would keep them from drifting.
title: Two ways to ask whether a daemon is new enough for a request
